title: coriflora bigelovii
intro: Coriflora bigelovii, commonly known as the Desert Lavender or Bigelow's Lavender, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is known for its calming and soothing properties, which can provide relief from stress and anxiety. The health benefits of Coriflora bigelovii include its ability to promote relaxation, improve sleep quality, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as volatile oils like camphor, linalool, and borneol.
